learner_operation: Transform the printed boundaries into a Type I region, determine intersections and upper/lower roles, calculate the absolute reciprocal Jacobian, integrate the vertical width, and select the exact area.

fixed_features.feature: Supplied invertible affine transformation and an area target
fixed_features.justification: The target canonical lesson gives the transformation and explicitly teaches four stages ending in area.
All twelve supplied practice questions use this response contract.

fixed_features.feature: Easy samples use quadratic caps with simple square heights
fixed_features.justification: Conservative same-method arithmetic tier grounded in q-38374 and the canonical quadratic cap; finite height domain is not itself a defect.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Change height or determinant magnitude; the correct numerical area and dependent solution must change.
answer_roles.observed: Height 1 to 4 changes area 4/3 to 32/3, diagram and bounds; shear a=1 to 8 preserves determinant one and area.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Plausible distractors may lie on either side of the area and need not include its unique negative mate. Correct numerical rank is incidental.
answer_roles.observed: Fixed method banks always include -A and force median A in every tested family. Shuffling positions does not break either cue.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Upward and downward caps are source-supported; reversing the cap orientation must reverse the corresponding bounds.
answer_roles.observed: Both appear in the hard sample; easy is explicitly an upward quadratic tier.

coverage.result: 39 independently chosen samples; all keys and five-value distinctness independently checked. All eight families exhibit the signed-pair shortcut.
5 inputs, 2 inventory duplicates, 3 survivors; shortcut succeeds 5/5 before and 3/3 after filtering. Heights are only 4 and 9 in the batch.

Six current banks replay exactly; q-82874 produces two fields instead of the current one. Five other current source profiles raise source id; these are explicitly unsupported, not certified as replayed.

counterfactuals.change: With easy a=1,k=0,seed=8191 fixed, change cap height h=1 to h=4.
counterfactuals.expected: Bounds ±1 become ±2 and area increases from 4/3 to 32/3; graph and explanation follow.
counterfactuals.observed: Printed boundaries independently integrated to these values; graph bytes differ; rendered prompts, plots and explanations agree. Native grader accepts each independently correct choice and rejects all four wrong choices.
counterfactuals.justification: Cap height changes the region, so it must change the integral and selection.

counterfactuals.change: With easy h=1,k=0,seed=8191 fixed, change unit-determinant shear a=1 to a=8.
counterfactuals.expected: Same transformed domain and area 4/3; xy formula and determinant matrix change, while the uv diagram and response value remain.
counterfactuals.observed: Printed-map oracle gives determinant 1 both times. Area and diagram hashes agree; prompts and matrix explanations follow the changed shear. Native grader accepts 4/3 in both and rejects each wrong choice.
counterfactuals.justification: An affine shear preserves area; this is a mathematically irrelevant change to the requested area, though the displayed coordinate expressions change.
